item.title: Greece tables bill for overseas postal voting
item.description: A draft law allowing Greeks living abroad to vote in parliamentary elections by post has been tabled in Parliament by Interior Minister Thodoris Livanios. item.title: Greek constitutional law giant Antonis Manitakis dies aged 82
item.description: Prominent constitutional law professor and former minister Antonis Manitakis has died at the age of 82. The Law School of the Aristotle University of Thessaloniki announced a two-day period of mourning, with classes suspended. The university said it was “devastated and with unspeakable sadness,” adding: “From today, legal science and Greek intellectual life are poorer.” […] The post Greek constitutional law giant Antonis Manitakis dies aged 82 appeared first on The Greek Herald.
